scripts.test: npm run plugins:check && cargo test && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/model/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts extensions/vscode/test/*.test.ts packages/reporter/test/*.test.ts && node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/web/test/e2e/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run plugins:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.web:build: npm run plugins:check && npm -w apps/web run build
